measurement_method.instrument: Playwright MCP accessibility snapshot [active] marker + mandatory Tab-continuation discriminator
measurement_method.why: The repo hook .claude/hooks/enforce-real-user.mjs blocks browser_evaluate/evaluate_script and carries no allowlist pattern for document.activeElement. The @allow-eval sentinel is scoped to UI-fix/debug work, explicitly not test runs, so it was not used. The snapshot marker plus Tab-once is the ticket's own stated equivalent assertion and is fully real-user.
measurement_method.instrument_validated: Confirmed [active] appears on the Password field pre-sign-in, and that genuine body focus (post-logout) sends Tab to the first document element - so the loose-focus signature is distinguishable, not inferred.
measurement_method.hook_gap_noted: A read-only document.activeElement probe is the same class as the axe / getComputedStyle / getBoundingClientRect exceptions the hook already allows. Adding a pattern for it would let a future focus-order run assert the ticket's literal criterion directly. Not changed here - out of scope for a QA run.
